_doc: Autonomous edge engine config. live=false => dry-run only (logs candidates, places NOTHING). Flip live=true to let it bet within the caps. Lane modes: 'bet' = real maker orders, 'log' = record to scorecard only (measure, no money), 'alert' = notify only. ENVELOPE: Aggressive, set by Rich 2026-06-04. (A one-off cap bump on 2026-06-10 was reverted same day -- caps change on a rule, not on a post-win impulse.)
_winrate_doc: WIN-RATE MAINTENANCE CONTROLLER. The engine only takes a sharp-lane bet if the model gives that side >= an effective win-prob floor. floor = win_floor_base + win_floor_gain*(target_win_rate - realized_hit_rate), clamped [base, max]. So if the realized hit rate dips below target it AUTO-TIGHTENS (demands stronger favorites -> rate climbs back); when we're above target it relaxes to base for more volume. min_fair_prob_sharp is the live floor the engine overwrites each run.
_sharp_doc: When a sharp number is a multi-book CONSENSUS (>= sharp_min_books books via The Odds API), trust a smaller gap (min_abs_edge_prob_sharp) -- a single-book de-vig still needs the wider 3pt floor. The net-EV-after-fee floor still applies to every bet.
_press_doc: PRESS lane (2026-06-10, Rich's idea): double-down on an OPEN bet with LOCKED daily profit, only where it STILL shows fresh real edge at the live ask, capped so the night stays net-green. Funded from profit, never principal. Starts in 'log' mode (proves it flags the right spots, spends nothing) -- flip to 'bet' to go live.
